In addition to the ongoing $50 discount on AirPods Pro 3, today's "Midday Roundup" from 9to5Toys headlines the $184 off deal on the titanium 46mm Apple Watch Series 11, $130 off on the aluminum Cellular models, with other models starting from $299. The rare Apple Keyboard and black Magic Mouse deals (for some reason) are still live, and my personal favorite — the Anker Prime Power Bank that doubles as a wall charger — also has a solid discount. However, today's real accessories highlight is the Nomad anniversary site-wide sale, with rare deals on MagSafe chargers, phone cases, Find My tracking cards, Watch bands, and more. See below for details.

Pick up the all-new AirPods Pro 3 this summer with nearly $50 off, other models start from $99

  • AirPods Pro 3　$200 (originally $249)
  • AirPods 4　$99 (originally $129)
  • AirPods 4 (with ANC)　$149 (originally $179)

Back in stock: Amazon has the titanium 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 at $184 off

This deal sold out in a flash yesterday — if you're interested, don't hesitate today. The 46mm GPS + Cellular Apple Watch Series 11 with Slate titanium case is once again $184 off at Amazon.

Amazon is currently selling the 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular model with Slate titanium case and Black Sport Band for $564.97 with free shipping.

This is one of the top-tier titanium case models, priced at $749. Taking advantage of today's likely short-lived deal to get $184 off is one of the best deals we've tracked on this configuration. It briefly dipped to $550 last month before Prime Day, but aside from that, this is the best price we've recorded for this setup.

To repeat, this deal is only for those set on the titanium case in Slate — because even with the discount, it's not cheap. However, the more popular aluminum models in the Series 11 lineup also have $100 and $130 discounts this week:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11　$299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11　$329 (originally $429)
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular　starting from $399 (originally $499)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular　starting from $399 (originally $529)

Rare Apple Keyboard and black Magic Mouse deals (for some reason) still live, historical lows starting from $80

Deals on popular Apple products are plentiful — $50 off AirPods Pro 3, up to $130 off the most popular Apple Watch Series 11 models — but Magic accessories are rarer. However, the base Magic Keyboard, the full-size model with Touch ID, and the black Apple Magic Mouse still have residual discounts from Prime Day.

Before these extended Prime Day discounts, deals on Apple accessories like these were very rare, and how long these deals will last is anyone's guess.

  • Black Apple Magic Mouse　$80 (originally $99)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard　$80 (originally $99)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard full-size with Touch ID　$145 (originally $179)

These three products are all the lowest prices we've tracked on Amazon. The black Apple Magic Mouse hasn't dropped this low in ages (I'm planning to grab a backup myself), while both Magic Keyboard models are at historical lows — the base version has only dropped to this price once before, and the Touch ID version has never gone below $158.

If you've been looking to replace your Apple Magic input devices, now might be the best time while these Prime Day prices are still available.

Nomad anniversary site-wide sale officially kicks off: rare deals on MagSafe chargers, phone cases, Watch bands, and more

Rare 20% off: Nomad's metal-and-glass 25W Qi2 MagSafe stand charger

There are plenty of cheaper 25W Qi2 MagSafe charging stands on the market, but almost none as premium and beautiful as Nomad's latest model. While it's not cheap, with the brand's 2026 anniversary sale now underway, we've tracked rare discounts on both the 2-in-1 and 3-in-1 models that can handle your entire Apple carry-on setup.

Nomad's 2026 anniversary sale is now live, with discounts galore on iPhone 17 cases, wallets, Apple Watch bands, and other charging accessories — but the deals on these Stand One and Stand One Max models are among the rarest:

  • Nomad 2-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One　$103 (originally $129)
  • Nomad 3-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One Max　$135 (originally $169)

What you're seeing now is Nomad's latest generation 25W Qi2 MagSafe stand charger. They're 20% off right now, which might not sound like much, but they almost never get discounted.

We're talking about solid metal construction, a very heavy premium build with glass accents, providing an elegant and luxurious home for your Apple devices.

The only downside to this sale is that the brand-new Cosmic Orange colorway is not included:

Rare price drop: Nomad Tracking Card — Apple Find My Pro model, Cosmic Orange, Google Find Hub, and more

The Nomad anniversary sale is now live. Although there was a bit of confusion earlier with the Tracking Card Pro and Air deals, they're now officially in effect. The discounts aren't huge, but they are rare price drops — both the Apple Find My and Google Find Hub versions start from $32.

Nomad's tracking cards are arguably the gold standard in their category, with MagSafe wireless charging support — I never leave home without one:

  • Tracking Card Air　$32 (originally $35) Apple Find My or Google Find Hub version
  • Tracking Card Pro　$41 (originally $45) all three colors

Nomad titanium Stratos Apple Watch band at 20% off for anniversary sale (rare price drop)

The Anker Prime Power Bank with display that doubles as a wall charger drops to $70 for summer — my personal favorite

The 2026 Anker summer sale continues, with discounts aplenty on the latest Prime charging devices, chargers, desktop chargers, 25W MagSafe stand chargers, and more. One of my personal favorites among the brand's portable charging products has also returned to its 2026 low of $69.99 — this 9,600mAh Anker Prime Power Bank that doubles as a wall charger.

The 9,600mAh Anker Prime Power Bank is currently selling on Amazon for $69.99 with free shipping. Originally priced as high as $90, we've tracked this deal several times this year, but I want to make sure we don't miss it this week because it's been the most practical portable charging device in my daily carry for nearly a year.

Of course, there are higher-wattage chargers in the brand's new product lineup, offering larger capacity and faster charging output, but this one works great for me. It's one of the more compact models, easily slipping into my everyday carry, while still featuring a smart display, USB-C connectivity, and enough power to handle a full day out — or longer.

Click here for my hands-on review.

It's also one of the few models in the lineup that doubles as a wall charger. There are foldable prongs on the back that let you plug directly into the wall to charge the internal battery while using it as a wall charger — I love this design, as it saves me from carrying an extra piece of gear just to charge it.

Today's accessories and charger deals:

  • This 140W 4-port charger can power your entire setup, today just $35 (41% off)
  • Charge your iPhone and AirPods with this dual Qi charging pad, now $30 (originally $70)
  • The 250W Anker Prime charging station with LCD display can replace six chargers, now as low as $95
  • Belkin 100W USB-C GaN wall charger drops to $25.50, a new Amazon all-time low
  • Satechi's latest ChargeView 140W desktop charger with display returns to Prime Day low of $80
  • Add four Matter-certified Edison smart bulbs to your Apple, Google, or Alexa smart home for under $8 each
  • Add Matter-enabled premium ambiance to your home with the Govee three-pack Permanent Outdoor Lights Prism, starting from $430
  • Add this DOCKCASE 2-in-1 USB-C SD card reader to your tech organizer, today just $7 (47% off)
  • Rare deal: Belkin 25W UltraCharge Pro 3-in-1 MagSafe stand charger hits new Amazon all-time low
  • Anker's latest 45W Nano charger with smart display still on sale for $26 in multiple colors
  • UGREEN FineTrack Slim Find My wallet tracker with MagSafe charging, today just $18
  • This magnetic Apple Watch band can be yours for just $20 (save 41%)
  • Anker 10-port flat-plug power strip now $20 on Amazon

Anker 3-port 160W smart display charger still at Prime Day price (33% off), other models from $8

In addition to ongoing discounts on the Anker smart-display Qi2 25W charger and the latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging station, we've also tracked the 3-port 160W Prime Charger with display returning to its Prime Day price (33% off).

Amazon's official Anker store currently sells the Smart Display 3-Port Prime Charger for $99.99 with free shipping.

For what is essentially a wall charger, the price isn't cheap, but it has a built-in smart display and can output up to 160W from a form factor "as compact as the AirPods Pro 3 charging case," making it portable yet powerful enough for all your devices.

More specifically, it can output up to 140W from a single USB-C port, capable of charging a 16-inch MacBook Pro from 0% to 50% in 25 minutes.

Speaking of the smart display, it features AnkerSense View technology that lets you "monitor power in real time on screen, instantly switch modes, and unlock custom modes via Bluetooth through the app."
